main_claim: Molecular state organizes functional manifolds and can complete omitted behavioral coordinates when headroom exists, but the effect is strongly target-, metric-, and dataset-dependent.
guardrails: Do not infer universal BehLift from selected positive targets; all-target distributions remain visible.
Condylis saturation is a headroom boundary, not evidence that molecules are irrelevant.
Zhao and much of Shainer remain conditional-completion boundaries.
Static WARP manifold reconstruction and dynamic WARP geometry are separate contracts.
AtlasLift may improve one geometry metric while worsening another.
